hs = {}
hs.status = "Progressing"
hs.message = ""
if obj.status ~= nil then
  if obj.status.health ~= nil then
    hs.status = obj.status.health.status
    if obj.status.health.message ~= nil then
      hs.message = obj.status.health.message
    end
  end
end
return hs

notifiers.service.webhook.discord:
url: $discord-webhook-url
headers:
  - name: Content-Type
    value: application/json

templates.template.app-sync-succeeded:
webhook:
  discord:
    method: POST
    body: |
      {"content": {{ printf "[Argo CD prod] %s 동기화 성공, revision %s" .app.metadata.name (.app.status.operationState.syncResult.revision | default "" | trunc 12) | toJson }}}
templates.template.app-sync-failed:
webhook:
  discord:
    method: POST
    body: |
      {"content": {{ printf "[Argo CD prod] %s 동기화 실패(%s): %s" .app.metadata.name .app.status.operationState.phase (.app.status.operationState.message | default "" | trunc 1500) | toJson }}}
templates.template.app-health-degraded:
webhook:
  discord:
    method: POST
    body: |
      {"content": {{ printf "[Argo CD prod] %s 상태 Degraded: %s" .app.metadata.name (.app.status.health.message | default "" | trunc 1500) | toJson }}}

triggers.trigger.on-sync-succeeded:
- description: 동기화 성공
  send: [app-sync-succeeded]
  when: app.status.operationState != nil and app.status.operationState.phase in ['Succeeded']
  oncePer: app.status.operationState?.syncResult?.revision
triggers.trigger.on-sync-failed:
- description: 동기화 실패
  send: [app-sync-failed]
  when: app.status.operationState != nil and app.status.operationState.phase in ['Error', 'Failed']
  oncePer: app.status.operationState?.syncResult?.revision
triggers.trigger.on-health-degraded:
- description: Health Degraded
  send: [app-health-degraded]
  when: app.status.health.status == 'Degraded'
